evidence.title: GitHub - arknow91/liquid-taffy: Three liquid interactions you can grab, pull, and let snap back — anchored dropdown, morphing dropdown and speed dial on one goo engine. · GitHub

name: liquid-taffy
summary: Three gooey React interactions — anchored dropdown, morphing dropdown and speed dial — on one shared grab-and-stretch liquid engine.
description: A reference implementation (not a package) of three liquid interactions built on one SVG metaball "goo" engine: two multi-select dropdowns (anchored and morphing) and a speed dial whose droplets break out of the button. A shared grab gesture stretches a liquid finger out of any surface and whips it back on release; GSAP spring curves, per-joint colour lighting on the dark frame, and every sound synthesized in the browser. Read the source for the filter math, border thresholds, tokens and accessibility notes.
contains: anchored dropdown, morphing dropdown and speed dial on one goo engine
shared grab gesture: press, drag, snap back with a four-bead liquid finger
SVG blur + alpha-threshold metaball filter with matched 1px border thresholds
GSAP CustomEase springs sampled from physical curves (22% and 18% overshoot)
per-gesture synthesized sound via Web Audio; each dial drop has its own pitch
light and dark frames; colours live in src/styles/tokens.css and one theme context
multi-select dropdown rows with menuitemcheckbox roles and reduced-motion handling
MIT licensed reference implementation; 163 GitHub stars
